title: Tallest trees by species
measure: Height in metres of the tallest known living tree of each species, measured by climbers with a tape or by laser. Shown by species because the tallest individual trees are nearly all coast redwoods in one Californian park.

entries.name: Coast redwood
entries.note: Hyperion, the tallest known living tree, measured in 2019. Its location is kept secret to protect it.
entries.source: Guinness World Records, Tallest tree living; Wikipedia

entries.name: South Tibetan cypress
entries.note: Found in 2023, making it the tallest known tree in Asia.
entries.source: Wikipedia, List of tallest trees (tallest by species)

entries.name: Sitka spruce
entries.source: Wikipedia, List of tallest trees (tallest by species)

entries.name: Coast Douglas-fir

entries.name: Yellow meranti
entries.note: Menara, the tallest tropical tree. It grows on a slope, so its height is an average of the two sides; Guinness World Records gives 98.53 m and early reports said 100.8 m.
entries.source: Wikipedia, List of tallest trees (tallest by species)

entries.name: Giant sequoia
entries.note: Not the tallest species, but the biggest trees on Earth by volume.
entries.source: Wikipedia, List of tallest trees (tallest by species)

entries.name: Mountain ash
entries.note: Centurion reached 100.5 m in 2018, then lost about 4 m in a 2019 bushfire.
entries.source: Wikipedia, List of tallest trees (tallest by species)

entries.name: Angelim vermelho
entries.note: Dinizia excelsa, the tallest tree in the Amazon. Ties with a brown top stringbark in Tasmania. A noble fir in Washington (89.9 m) is left out, as it may have died.
entries.source: Wikipedia, List of tallest trees (tallest by species)
